name: Analytical Single Scattering with Constant Extinction
definition: A shading method for volumetric particles that assumes constant extinction ($\sigma_t(z) = \sigma$) and visibility ($Vis(z) = 1$) within a tetrahedron to allow analytical integration of the scattering equation.
summary: Analytical Single Scattering with Constant Extinction computes single scattering by assuming uniform extinction, trading physical accuracy for computational simplicity and introducing visible geometric artifacts.
